## Overview

After running a simulation experiment, the result object provides structured access
to all output data — raw state variables, derived observations (BOLD, FC, PSD),
algorithm history, and optimization traces.

## Basic Usage

```python
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment

exp = SimulationExperiment.from_db("...")
result = exp.run()

# Access state variable time series
result.data           # (time × nodes × state_vars) array
result.time           # time vector
```

## Result Structure

The result mirrors the YAML experiment specification:

```python
result.integration                     # Main simulation data
result.integration.observations.bold   # BOLD signal (if defined)
result.algorithms.fic                  # Algorithm results (if defined)
```

## Plotting

```python
result.plot()          # Default time series plot
```
